name: Lightning Terminal
description: Lightning Terminal is the easiest way to manage inbound and outbound liquidity on the Lightning Network. Keep your channels open and the funds flowing. It provides a visual interface for interacting with your channels and balances using Loop.
short_desc: The easiest way to manage channel liquidity
author: Lightning Labs
